viewing_check: Find a stamp on the bolt ring or end jump ring (375 / 9ct; 'SF', 'silver filled', '1/20 12K GF' or 'bonded' means not solid). Weigh it: max A$180 at 5 g, plus or minus A$53 per gram. Squeeze a link gently: hollow links dent and weigh light. Magnet test the clasp spring housing only.
